title: Scam Shield
idea: Reads incoming messages and warns when one looks like a scam, with a plain-language reason.
built: A phone-number and link checker that flags known scam patterns in pasted messages. No voice or call support.
improve: Add voice call screening and support for regional languages.

title: Quiet Hours
idea: Schedules do-not-disturb windows for night workers based on their shift rota.
built: Reads a shared rota and mutes chosen apps in the right windows. Single user only.
improve: Let families share the same quiet windows so others know when not to call.

title: Receipt Lens
idea: Photograph a receipt and get a tidy spending breakdown by category.
built: Extracts line items from receipt photos and groups them. Accuracy drops on crumpled paper.
improve: Add monthly trends and shared budgets for flatmates.

title: Lab Notes
idea: Turns messy lab-meeting audio into clean notes and action items.
built: Transcribes a recording and lists decisions. Speaker names are not tracked.
improve: Identify speakers and link action items to a task board.

title: Repo Radar
idea: Shows which open issues in a repo are friendly to first-time contributors.
built: Ranks issues by labels and age. Does not read the issue text itself.
improve: Use a local model to judge how clear and small each issue is.

title: Changelog Bot
idea: Writes human-readable release notes from merged pull requests.
built: Summarises merged pull requests into a markdown file on each release.
improve: Group changes by user impact rather than by commit order.

title: Docs Doctor
idea: Finds out-of-date lines in a README by comparing it with the code.
built: Flags README sections whose function names no longer exist.
improve: Suggest the fix as a ready-to-merge pull request.

title: Bus Buddy
idea: Live campus shuttle times and a seat-share board for late classes.
built: Shows shuttle arrival times from a manual feed. No live GPS.
improve: Add GPS from the driver phone and a walking-group option at night.

title: Doubt Desk
idea: Students post a doubt, and a local model drafts a first answer before a senior replies.
built: A question board with an AI draft answer. Seniors can edit and approve.
improve: Match each doubt to the senior who answered a similar one before.

title: Split Easy
idea: Splits shared bills from a photo of the receipt and settles up over UPI.
built: Reads a receipt, lets friends claim items, and shows who owes whom.
improve: Remember regular groups and suggest the fewest payments to settle.

title: Trip Pad
idea: A shared itinerary board for group trips with voting on plans.
built: Group board with places, dates and votes. Planning is fully manual.
improve: Suggest a route and a day plan from the places the group voted for.

title: Scheme Finder
idea: Tells citizens which government schemes they may qualify for, in simple language.
built: A short questionnaire that lists matching schemes. Text only, English only.
improve: Add voice input and local languages so older people can use it unaided.
